meta.title: Ping From Here
meta.description: Measure your estimated latency to major cloud regions from wherever you're connected right now.

hero.tagline: How far are you from the cloud?
hero.description: Measures HTTP latency to 28 cloud regions across AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare — straight from your browser.

footer.methodologyNote: Estimated latency via HTTP HEAD requests — not ICMP ping. Each region is sampled 5 times and the median is shown, which absorbs the cold-start bias of the first request (DNS + TLS handshake). All regions are measured in parallel from your browser. No data leaves your device.
footer.gcpAttribution: GCP endpoints via gcping.com (Google DevRel, Apache 2.0).
footer.cloudflareNote: Cloudflare shows your nearest edge node, not a specific datacenter region.
